meta.title: Draft secondary lean scores
meta.formula: contribution_axis = signed_score * actor_axis_value / 2; lean_axis = clamp(mean(contributions), -2, +2); lean_composite = mean(lean_economic, lean_social). FOR shifts toward actor placement; AGAINST shifts away (via signed_score sign).
meta.caveat: Secondary view: left/right lean (reader convenience). The primary measure is for/against named actors. The left/right split is contested in South Africa; AfriForum, MK Party and the GNU are especially hard to place.
meta.cassian_note: Cassian DM seed is reference-only (data/external_references.json). It is not imported as primary findings and not used as lean inputs. Secondary lean is derived solely from MediaWatch primary findings × actor_axis_map.

axis_legend.lean_composite: mean of economic and social lean; negative≈left, positive≈right on this draft map

meta.accountability_exempt_treatment: Findings with signed_score null (accountability_exempt) are included in n_included with contribution 0 when the actor is mapped, preserving the treatment used on 5 Nov 2026.
meta.findings_only_treatment: When flag is findings_only (n_included < 5), lean_economic, lean_social and lean_composite are stored as null. Raw means are not stored; they can be recomputed from audit_contributions. Numeric lean is not shown.
meta.cowan_frame_note: Cowan sample relabelled 15 Nov 2026: KC-01 counter_pull; other coded Cowan findings purposive. Not a neutral_random draw.
meta.rounding_rule: Axis means (lean_economic, lean_social) and lean_composite are computed from unrounded values: lean_composite = mean(lean_economic, lean_social) before rounding. Each displayed lean is rounded to 3 decimal places only at output. Do not average already-rounded axis scores.
